title: Fix a room scheduler against written rules
prompt: Room bookings made with scheduler.py break several of the rules in RULES.md: which intervals are valid, which bookings conflict and which one a Conflict names, how ids are given out, what cancel removes, how bookings are sorted and what free() returns. Fix scheduler.py so that every rule holds. Python 3 standard library only. Do not change RULES.md or test_scheduler.py.
